subject: general
question: Which of the following should be managed to ensure sustainability ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Natural resources.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Natural resources** are the foundation of **sustainability**.
 
• They provide the essential resources for human well-being, including **food, water, and energy.**
 
• **Proper management **of natural resources ensures their availability for future generations.
 
• This includes sustainable practices such as** conservation, restoration, and responsible** use.
 
• Natural resources also play a crucial role in **mitigating climate change** and **promoting biodiversity.**
 
• For example, forests absorb **carbon dioxide,** while wetlands provide habitat for a variety of wildlife.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• While **industries** provide employment opportunities and contribute to economic growth, they can have **negative impacts** on the environment if not managed properly.

 
 
• For example, industrial activities can lead to air and water pollution, as well as contribute to **greenhouse gas emissions.**
 
 
 
• The choice of **crop varieties** can impact the environment.
 
 
• Some crops require **more water and pesticides **than others, which can lead to negative impacts Mining activities can have negative impacts on the environment, including water pollution, soil erosion, and habitat destruction.
 
 
 
• The by-products of **mining, **such as tailings and waste rock, can also have **negative impacts** on the environment if not managed properly.
